correctness.rationale: Full all-degree proof: hemisphere operator blocks are [1/2,gamma;gamma,1/2], gamma positive and given by associated-Legendre Lagrange Wronskian and double factorial values. Central-binomial f is log-convex; Wallis bounds control odd parity and prove strict unique top m=l. Eigenvalue multiplicities and highest-weight optimizer follow. Stirling supplies sharp limit. Reproducible scipy quadrature checked 496 blocks through degree 30 and asymptotics separately, without treating finite tests as proof.

originality.rationale: The all-mask half-energy rank result published-finding corpus:0284b88cef7a has unspecified noncentral singular values and does not yield the sharp adjacent-degree spectrum or top-order maximizing modes. Simons--Dahlen 2006 eq. (50) supplies general cap matrix integrals, not an exact all-degree adjacent-band optimizer; Jaming--Speckbacher 2020 Thm. 4.4 is a Nyquist-density estimate for a different low-pass problem. Exact searches of the full source and comparison of mathematical implications found no covering theorem. Historical priority remains provisional.

value.rationale: This is an exact global uncertainty bound for the minimal nontrivial two-eigenvalue spherical-harmonic frequency band. It gives every concentration eigenvalue and all optimal modes including the lowest-degree zonal case, plus a sharp high-degree ceiling strictly below one. The precise band spectrum and highest-order optimizer for degrees at least one are motivated by hemisphere Slepian/bandpass reconstruction and not solely by routine numerical computation.
